quickskin.settings.enable_preview: Show your character in a corner while you play
quickskin.settings.enable_preview.toolti: A small view of your character in a corner of the screen while you play.
quickskin.settings.enable_preview_custom: Allow moving and resizing the previews
Drag a preview with the left mouse button to move it, and use the mouse wheel to resize it.
quickskin.settings.disable_transparency: Show transparent parts of skins as opaque
Useful if you see holes in badly made skins.
quickskin.settings.show_title_preview: Show your character on the title screen
quickskin.settings.show_title_preview.to: Your character and its buttons beside the title screen menu.
quickskin.settings.show_pause_preview: Show your character in the pause menu
quickskin.settings.show_pause_preview.to: Your character and its buttons beside the pause menu.
quickskin.settings.compact_change_skin_b: Compact the Change Skin button to make it smaller
Show the Change Skin button on the title screen and pause menu as a small icon.
quickskin.settings.hide_builtin_capes.to: The cape menu only shows the capes you imported.
quickskin.settings.menu_background: Minecraft's blurred background instead of stars
quickskin.settings.menu_background.toolt: Quick Skin's menus show the blurred game behind them, like Minecraft's own menus.
quickskin.settings.keybind_assign: Assign a key to open the skin menu
quickskin.settings.keybind_change: Change the key that opens the skin menu
quickskin.settings.disable_transparency_: Turn off Quick Skin's transparency system for every player
Every skin on this server is shown without transparency. Useful if someone uses invisible or see-through skins to troll.
quickskin.settings.cooldown_seconds: Seconds to wait between skin changes
quickskin.settings.cooldown_seconds.tool: How long a player waits after changing skin before changing it again. 0 means no wait.
quickskin.settings.own_skin_tooltip: On startup, downloads your Minecraft account's skin and adds it to your list.
